# ScramServerTrigger

*Server*

Named click target from `c.getServer().getTrigger(id)` or `c.getWorld().getTrigger(id)`, saved in the world's triggers.json. A right or left click on it runs its triggers, set in the functional editor, and the global events "Trigger: right click" / "Trigger: left click"; there `c.getValue("trigger")` is the clicked trigger.

A trigger is either on a block ([`setBlock`](#setblock)): its hitboxes are the block's outline and follow the block, unless it has hitboxes of its own ([`setCustomHitboxes`](#setcustomhitboxes)); or a shape around a point ([`setPoint`](#setpoint)): a box, cylinder, sphere or wedge like a collision's, which may stand in empty space.

Setters save triggers.json and synchronize clients at once. The handle stays bound to the trigger through renames; after it is removed or the world catalog is reloaded, methods throw `IllegalStateException`. Requires the server game thread.

```js
var lever = c.getServer().createTrigger("lever", "minecraft:overworld", 10, 64, 10);
var orb = c.getServer().createTrigger("orb", "minecraft:overworld", 0, 70, 0).setPoint(0.5, 70.5, 0.5).sphere(0.5);
```

### setBlock {#setblock}

::: member

Puts the trigger on a block: its hitboxes become the outline of the block there (or its own hitboxes, see

[`setCustomHitboxes`](#setcustomhitboxes)). They follow the block: an opened door turns them, a broken block leaves none.

```js
c.getServer().getTrigger("lever").setBlock(12, 64, 3);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### setBlock {#setblock-2}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | block coordinates, not null; fractions are dropped |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger, see [`setBlock(int, int, int)`](#setblock)

:::

### setPoint {#setpoint}

::: member

Makes the trigger a shape around a point, which may be in empty space; the shape is set with [`box`](#box),

[`cylinder`](#cylinder), [`sphere`](#sphere) or [`wedge`](#wedge) (a 1 x 1 x 1 box by default).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | point x, the middle of the shape |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | point y |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | point z |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### setPoint {#setpoint-2}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `point` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | the middle of the shape, not null |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger, see [`setPoint(double, double, double)`](#setpoint)

:::

### hasCustomHitboxes {#hascustomhitboxes}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether a block trigger uses its own hitboxes instead of the block's outline

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `customHitboxes` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true to use the hitboxes added with [`addHitbox`](#addhitbox), false to follow the block's outline |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### getHitboxes {#gethitboxes}

::: member

**Returns** `List<ScriptBox>` — new boxes: the own hitboxes of a block trigger, in blocks from the block's corner

:::

### addHitbox {#addhitbox}

::: member

Adds an own hitbox of a block trigger and turns them on ([`setCustomHitboxes`](#setcustomhitboxes)). Corners are in blocks from the block's corner, at most 8 blocks out of the block, e.g. `0, 0, 0, 1, 0.5, 1` is the lower half.

```js
c.getServer().getTrigger("lever").addHitbox(0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.75, 0.6, 0.75);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `minX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |
| `minY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |
| `minZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |
| `maxX` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |
| `maxY` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |
| `maxZ` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) |  |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

::: member

Turns the shape of a point trigger around its middle, like a collision: roll, then pitch, then yaw.

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `pitch` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around X in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | rotation around Y in degrees |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

### hasOutline {#hasoutline}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether players see the selection outline on the trigger while they look at it

:::

### setOutline {#setoutline}

::: member

Shows or hides the selection outline, the thin black frame of a looked-at block, on the trigger while a player looks at it. A block trigger on a real block also gets the block's own outline.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outline` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true to show it; true by default |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### hasCollision {#hascollision}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the trigger's hitboxes are solid, see [`setCollision`](#setcollision)

:::

### setCollision {#setcollision}

::: member

Makes the hitboxes solid for entities, like a collision: the shape of a point trigger, the own hitboxes of a block trigger (a block trigger on the block's outline is as solid as its block anyway). They stay clickable.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collision` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true to make them solid; false by default |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |

### getTriggers {#gettriggers}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) — new copy of the triggers of the button: compounds with `type`, `isServer`, `maxDelay` and the settings of their type; change it and pass it to [`setTriggers`](#settriggers)

:::

### setTriggers {#settriggers}

::: member

Replaces the triggers of a button.

```js
var trigger = c.getServer().getTrigger("lever");
var actions = trigger.getTriggers("right");

actions.getCompound(0).putInt("maxDelay", 3);
trigger.setTriggers("right", actions);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |
| `triggers` | [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) | list of trigger compounds of registered types, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### addScriptTrigger {#addscripttrigger}

::: member

Adds a server script trigger to a button, running every click.

```js
c.getServer().getTrigger("lever").addScriptTrigger("right", "doors/open", "main");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of a server script, not empty |
| `function` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | name of its function, not empty |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### addCommandTrigger {#addcommandtrigger}

::: member

Adds a command trigger to a button, running every click as the clicking player.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |
| `command` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | command with or without the leading slash, not empty |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### clearTriggers {#cleartriggers}

::: member

Removes all triggers of a button.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |

**Returns** [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) — this trigger

:::

### click {#click}

::: member

Clicks the trigger for a player, without checking where the player looks: runs the global event and the trigger's own triggers of the button as if the player clicked its middle; their frequency applies, and client triggers run for that player only.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"right"` or `"left"` |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | connected player in the trigger's dimension, not null |

:::

### getNbtCompound {#getnbtcompound}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — new copy of all settings; change it and pass it to [`setNbtCompound`](#setnbtcompound)

:::

### setNbtCompound {#setnbtcompound}

::: member

Replaces all settings of the trigger (place, hitboxes, shape, triggers) with the data, saves and synchronizes it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settings` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | complete trigger settings, not null; copied and validated; the UUID stays |

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |

::: member

Deletes this trigger from triggers.json; its handles become invalid.

:::
